_doc: Curated LLM prompt suite for the tool/generation scorecard (scripts/eval-tools.mjs). Each case is a realistic plain-English diagram request + the chart-type id(s) a correct `suggest_chart_type` should land on (any one of `accept` counts). Grow this from real usage (MCP telemetry) over time. `accept` ids must exist in chart-types.ts.
